Asset type: ONE clean background-only master-room proposal for EmotionalUI, 4:3 landscape. Use the supplied reference as the edit target. This is a faithful background reconstruction, not a new interior design.
Primary request: remove ALL software interface elements from the supplied image and reconstruct the obscured ROOM behind them. Remove every word, title, greeting, date, clock, icon, line, button, rectangular card, cover illustration and footer. There must be no Zelda/Hollow Knight artwork or any other game art remaining. Reconstruct plausible room surfaces behind occlusions; do not replace the left half with a blank flat fill.
Keep the reference's actual atmosphere and composition: an intimate dark timber Japanese-influenced mountain/lake refuge, viewed from within, large tall window structure spanning center-right, thick warm wooden frames, delicately shadowed curtains and foliage at left; beyond the window, a quiet lakeside mountain village with a handful of tiny warm lights, layered blue-grey forest and a recognizable distant mountain peak, muted dusty peach and slate twilight sky. A low wooden tabletop/reading ledge across lower-right with a dark ceramic mug, two small stacked books, plants along the far right, and the existing small rectangular amber lantern/lamp on the right. Soft low floor seating/cushion and woven rug along lower foreground. Do not turn this into an empty tatami hall or an architectural showroom.
Preserve the existing viewpoint, window geometry, horizon, tabletop position, lamp placement, balance of shadows and light, and restrained color palette as closely as possible. Retain the welcoming proximity of the tabletop and lantern, the depth of the village and landscape, and a quiet darker left-side interior suitable for UI. Do not enlarge the sky at the expense of this intimate interior. Weather can later be expressed through this same window; no weather variants now.
Style: match the reference's mature painterly lofi atmosphere with soft naturalistic illustration, delicate restrained texture and cinematic quiet light. Neither photographic stock rendering nor bright flat cartoon. Interior ink-brown and charcoal shadows, contained warm amber lamp, outdoors desaturated blue-green mountains and smoky peach dusk. Low saturation, low glare, carefully readable shapes at 640x480.
Constraints: output one seamless full-bleed BACKGROUND ONLY, no UI or frames, no text whatsoever, no people, no logos, no game covers, no commercial characters, no new furniture or decorations, no generic office desk, no giant bright lamp, no empty panoramic resort hall, no collage. Preserve original composition instead of making another interpretation.
